title: Message templates
intro: What guests are sent, per alert and channel. Use the variable buttons to add a guest's details. SMS stays off for an alert until you write its text.
readOnly: Only managers, admins and owners can change templates.
subject: Subject
bodyHint: Variables look like {{ticket}}. Put text in [square brackets] to drop it when a variable has no value.
revertDescription: Your custom text is removed and the next message uses the default. Earlier versions stay in the history.

error.unknown_variable: {{name}} isn't a variable this message can use.
error.permission_denied: You don't have permission to change templates.
error.unknown: The template was not saved. Try again.

queue.title: Messages and look: {{name}}
queue.messagesIntro: Reword what guests in this queue are sent. Anything you leave alone uses your organization's wording.
queue.saveFailed: We couldn't save that. Try again.

accent.label: Accent colour
accent.hint: Leave empty to use your organization's colour. Format #rrggbb.
accent.low: This colour is too light to read on a white page (it needs 4.5:1). Pick a darker one; {{text}} text would read on it, but the accent is also used for links and borders.
accent.preview: This is how the accent looks

welcome.label: Welcome text
welcome.hint: Shown to guests joining this queue. {{count}} characters left.

telegram.notConfigured: Telegram updates are off. Set up a bot to offer them: see docs/ops/telegram.md.

locked: Added to every text; you can't change it
lockedHint: The business name and the opt-out line are added to every text and can't be edited.
otherLocale: Guests who pick Spanish get your English text for this message. Save a Spanish version to replace it.

guard.url: Texts can't contain links or web addresses other than {{status_link}}.
guard.contact: Texts can't contain phone numbers, email addresses or tel: links.
guard.unsubscribe_url: Texts can't contain an unsubscribe link; guests reply STOP instead.
guard.segments: This message is longer than 3 text segments once the business name and opt-out line are added. Shorten it.
guard.adjacent: Put a space around {{name}} so it can't join other text into a link.
guard.term: Texts can't contain “{{term}}”: it reads as marketing or works against STOP.

test.title: Send me a test
test.ready: Test texts go to {{phone}}. The test uses your saved text, not unsaved changes.
test.sent: Sent to {{phone}}. It should arrive within a minute.
test.phoneHint: With the country code, for example +1 415 555 0123. We text it a code to check it's yours.
test.wrongCode: That code doesn't match. Check the text and try again.

error.rate_limited: Too many texts today. Try again tomorrow.
error.invalid_input: Enter the number with its country code, starting with +.
error.code_expired: That code has expired. Ask for a new one.
error.not_found: There's no text for this message to send yet.
error.permission_denied: Only managers, admins and owners can send test texts.
